description:
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting-edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services this is possible!

As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.

Come closer to #LifeAtOrange!


What are we looking for?

We are eager to bring the best DevOps Engineer by our side! Can you make IT happen?

Take the opportunity to boost your career in IT and work with the latest technologies. Share your passion about IT Innovation with us. We will offer you a dynamic environment where you can grow and develop.

Role:


As DevOps Engineer, you will be part of an Agile project team working in sprints to build and deliver new platforms, services around Data for Cloud products.

You will contribute to the study, technology proposition, development, integration and testing of the solution.
You will participate in all Scrum Events such as Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Retrospective meetings.

During these meetings you will take tasks from the team’s backlog each sprint, implement them and present the new features in the review meeting at the end of the sprint.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Integration, Packaging, Testing and Acceptance of new features
  • Prepare releases for specific modules/scripts, when needed
  • Prepare and sustain part of the demo meeting at the end of the Sprint
  • Prepare/Update the related documentation of the integrated service
  • Troubleshoot, report and resolve issues, appearing during installation, integration and acceptance phases
  • Improve existing scripts/tools/processes or Develop new ones, according to the needs, in order to facilitate the automation/ease of installation, configuration, testing, operation, etc.
  • Cooperate with Solution Architect and other project stakeholders, to ensure the delivery plan and quality are being met
  • For more testing related missions: Prepare/Deploy the test environment, execute installations, test cases and scripts
  • Level 3 support on live services (business hours)

What you need to know/have:

Must Haves:

  • Virtualization / Cloud Native technologies (Google Cloud and AWS)
  • Experience with automation deployment tools (e.g. creating scripts to install, configure and maintain applications - Ansible, Terraform)
  • Kubernetes deployment frameworks (Tanzu, Anthos)
  • Linux systems (system and network parameters)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g.: MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB)
  • Previous software development; packaging and versioning of software applications

 

We would also appreciate (nice to have):

  • Experience with ELK, Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus, Apache
  • Experience with gitlab CI/CD or github actions
  • Experience with Agile / Scrum / SAFe methodologies
  • Knowledge of the DevOps specific tools like GIT, Jenkins, Selenium, Puppet
  • Strong scripting skills: bash, Python, etc.
  • Experience with Docker
  • Network concepts: switching, load balancing, routing, firewalls, IPs, DNS
  • Familiarity with gRPC, Kafka, RabbitMQ



Working language(s): excellent English, French will be a plus.


What’s in it for you:

  • Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s;
  • Electronic Meal Tickets
  • Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too;
  • #WFH & Flexible hours;
  • Professional GSM subscription;
  • Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!];
  • Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services;
  • Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring;
  • Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen;

 

 

Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.

Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.

 

At Orange, you can.

IMPORTANT

In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered.

 

 

We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
